# Learn to Paint Watercolor

> A comprehensive watercolor instruction platform by Matthew White offering tutorials, courses, and community support for painters of all levels.

Learn to Paint Watercolor provides free and premium resources including weekly blog tutorials, structured courses (Watercolor Essentials, Master Skies), and a membership-based Watercolor Community with peer critique and the Success Path program. The site emphasizes foundational techniques like color mixing, composition, depth creation, and subject-specific tutorials for landscapes, skies, and water.

## Key Topics

- Watercolor painting
- Painting techniques
- Color mixing
- Composition and depth
- Landscape painting
- Sky techniques
- Watercolor Community
- Matthew White
- Beginner guides
- Watercolor fundamentals
- Wet-into-wet technique
- Value studies
- Online courses
- Artist community
- Free resources

## Getting Started

- [Homepage](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com): Main hub offering watercolor tutorials, courses, and community by Matthew White
- [Free Resources](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/freeresources): Free resources hub including 5 Essential Steps guide and supplies information
- [5 Step Planning Guide](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2150431669): Free 5-step planning guide for watercolor painting composition and technique
- [Accelerate Watercolor Growth](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/tips-I-wish-I-knew): Essential beginner tips for accelerating watercolor learning and skill growth

## Core Techniques & Tutorials

- [Creating Depth in Watercolor (The Three Keys)](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/creatingdepth): Guide to three key techniques for creating depth in watercolor paintings
- [Watercolor Sky Techniques](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/watercolor-sky-techniques): Four sky painting techniques using wet-into-wet and color mixing methods
- [10 Quick Watercolor Tips](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/10tips): Ten practical tips for brush technique, paper selection, and color mixing
- [One Simple Tip](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/one-simple-tip): Single transformative watercolor tip using grayscale value study technique
- [Watercolor Painting Background](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/watercolor-painting-background): Guide to painting complementary backgrounds that support focal points

## Subject-Specific Tutorials

- [How to Paint Landscapes](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/landscape-tips): Four watercolor landscape tips using Rule of Thirds and depth techniques
- [Paint the Sunset](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/paint-sunset-in-watercolor-tutorial): Step-by-step sunset painting tutorial with light-to-dark technique
- [Paint a Crashing Wave](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/painting-waves): Full-length tutorial for painting crashing waves with color mixing techniques
- [Drawings to Guide Paintings](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/drawing): Drawing tips for watercolor sketches covering composition and perspective basics

## Courses & Community

- [Store](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/store): Store page featuring Watercolor Essentials, Master Skies, and community courses
